links.outcome: Accuracy difference between closed-ended (cued) and open-ended formats on clinical vignettes
links.effect: DeepSeek R1 86.4% closed vs 80.9% open; Gemini 3 Pro 90.7% closed vs 88.9% open, showing benchmark format inflates accuracy.
links.quote: While the closed-ended format may inflate accuracy due to cueing, the open-ended evaluation yielded richer insights into the fidelity of reasoning.

links.outcome: Citation relevance in open-ended model responses
links.effect: DeepSeek R1 averaged 18.7 references per case with 5.2 unrelated; Gemini 3 Pro averaged 22.5 references with 1.9 unrelated.
links.quote: In a structured review of open-ended responses, DeepSeek R1 produced an average of 18.7 (range 0-52) references per case, with 5.2 unrelated references and 13.1 (range 3-67) reasoning steps, whereas Gemini 3 Pro averaged 22.5 (range 12-50) references, 1.9 (range 0-8) unrelated references, and 4.4 (range 1-10) reasoning steps per case.

screen.reason: Evaluates reasoning large language models (DeepSeek R1 and Gemini 3 Pro) on the MMLU-Pro health subset benchmark across open- and closed-ended clinical vignettes without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
